integrity: Finite exhaustive recurrence and exact rational checker supplied; all assertions are reproducible from the embedded standalone Python script. The first-public date is that of the motivating source, not a publication claim for this finding.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact exhaustiveness for four candidates and three seats, electorate sizes 1 to 7, nonempty ballots, all tie branches and Kelly extension only. Tie-sensitive; no implication for all deterministic tie-breakers or larger candidate sets. A logically equivalent unindexed earlier theorem cannot be excluded. Independent scientific verification has not been performed.
title: The sharp seven-voter Kelly no-show boundary for four-candidate sequential PAV
